title: Incarnate Son obedient unto the cross
source_text: IX. Quod ut effectum daret, tempore per divinam providentiam praestituto, & propheticis oraculis praedicto, Filius ille Dei, qui rapinam non ducebat se esse aequalem Deo, accepta servi forma inter homines comparuit, omnesque naturae humanae miserias atque infirmitates, excepto peccato, ultro in se suscepit; vitaque sanctissima & innocentissima per aliquot annos in his terris peracta, sponte tandem morti maledictae & probrosae nostro nomine se objecit, Deo Patri factus obediens usque ad mortem, mortem autem crucis.
pass_a_gloss: That this might take effect, at the time appointed by divine providence and foretold by prophetic oracles, that Son of God, who did not count equality with God a thing to be grasped, appeared among men having taken the form of a servant, and freely took on himself all the miseries and infirmities of human nature except sin; and after living a most holy and innocent life for some years on earth, he at last of his own will exposed himself in our name to a cursed and shameful death, becoming obedient to God the Father unto death, even the death of the cross.
pass_b_english: At the prophesied time the Son took servant form, sinless human weakness, and holy life.
Willingly he obeyed unto cursed, shameful cross-death in our name.
